protocol: 4 warm questions then16 held train questions; freeze before interventions

interventions.intact: S, convolution and external recall all retained
interventions.no_recall: zero all recalled-value contributions throughout the example
interventions.zero_S: clear all24 live S matrices at first answer-supervised window; retain convolution and recall
interventions.zero_S_no_recall: same live S cut, external recall off throughout
interventions.zero_conv_no_recall: clear convolution at answer window; S retained, recall off
interventions.zero_all_no_recall: clear S and convolution at answer window, recall off; aligned suffix must yield zero question gap

score: answer NLL and correct-question minus swapped-question conditioning; joint candidate matching is not free generation accuracy
interpretation: At matched question lengths and identical post-cut suffixes, carried S retains most question-dependent information even without external recall. Clearing live S nearly abolishes this signal; clearing only short convolution does not. This diagnoses forward information carriage, not the efficacy of extra old-native learning.
scope: Frozen interventions after reconstructed held SFT; no optimizer updates during probes. Candidate matching is not free generation accuracy; long1024-2048token equal-question pairs absent in official dev.
